source_caption:
🎬 Hoppers (2026)

Hoppers follows Mabel, a passionate young animal lover who discovers an incredible new technology that allows human consciousness to be transferred into realistic robotic animals. Determined to protect a threatened natural habitat, Mabel uses the invention to enter the animal kingdom as a robotic beaver. What begins as an exciting adventure quickly becomes an extraordinary journey when she meets King George, a charismatic beaver, and discovers the complicated relationships between animals and humans. As she becomes involved in the animals’ fight to save their home, Mabel must use her courage, creativity, and determination to bring different worlds together. Pixar’s Hoppers combines hilarious comedy, imaginative animation, and heartfelt storytelling while celebrating friendship, teamwork, wildlife, and the importance of protecting nature.

🎭 Genre: Animation • Adventure • Comedy • Family • Sci-Fi

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 1h 45m • PG

🎥 Director: Daniel Chong

✍️ Writer: Jesse Andrews

📺 Where to Watch: Disney+ in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Hoppers is a 2026 American animated science fiction comedy film directed by Daniel Chong from a screenplay by Jesse Andrews and a story by Chong and Andrews. Produced by Pixar Animation Studios for Walt Disney Pictures, the film stars the voices of Piper Curda, Bobby Moynihan, Jon Hamm, Kathy Najimy, and Dave Franco. It follows Mabel Tanaka (Curda), an animal-loving college student who transfers her consciousness into a robotic beaver to communicate with animals and save their habitat from destruction, inadvertently sparking an uprising among them. Chong began developing Hoppers after returning to Pixar in December 2020, and the project was officially announced in August 2024. Mark Mothersba
